name: LMMS-EVAL
description: LMMS-EVAL is a unified and standardized multimodal benchmark framework designed to evaluate large multimodal models across over 50 tasks, promoting transparent and reproducible evaluations. It includes a pruned version called LMMS-EVAL LITE for efficient evaluation and a continuously updating benchmark called Multimodal LIVEBENCH to assess models' generalization abilities in real-world scenarios with low cost and zero contamination.
typical_sota_score: varies widely across tasks; unknown aggregated score
reputation: A widely used unified evaluation framework for multimodal models, with LMMS-EVAL and its variants adopted by researchers for standardized comparison across many tasks.
notes: Focuses on evaluation trilemma of coverage, cost, and contamination; includes a leaderboard and open-source codebase.
